items.title: At least 90 dead in Chinese coal mine explosion, state media reports
items.description: The explosion took place at 19:29 local time on Friday at a coal mine in northern China.

items.title: Putin vows retaliation after accusing Ukraine of hitting student dormitory
items.description: Ukraine says it hit Russia's elite Rubicon drone military unit in a Moscow-occupied region.

items.title: SpaceX launches massive Starship V3 rocket on test flight
items.description: The largest and most powerful rocket in history blasted off after its first attempted launch was postponed.

items.title: Rubio tries to reassure Nato allies over US troop deployments
items.description: President Donald Trump says he wants to send more troops to Poland, a week after his officials cancelled a similar deployment.

items.title: Ebola risk raised to 'very high' in DR Congo
items.description: The head of the UN health agency says the risk in the wider region is "high", but it remains "low" at the global level.

items.title: Race for French presidency sees ex-PM Philippe as early favourite to beat populists
items.description: Latest polls suggest the centre-right figure is the only candidate who can defeat Marine Le Pen or Jean-Luc Mélenchon.

items.title: Tulsi Gabbard to resign as US national intelligence director
items.description: Gabbard who has been largely out of public view during recent US operations says she is leaving due to her husband's illness.

items.title: Gaza flotilla activists allege abuse by Israeli forces while detained
items.description: The detainees say they were slapped, hit, humiliated and even subjected to sexual violence, but Israel's prison service says the allegations are false.

items.title: Rubio visits India to sell energy as Iran oil shock persists
items.description: The top US diplomat has made statements offering to support India’s energy needs - but should Delhi give in?

items.title: US government releases UFO sighting reports - 'Orbs swarming in all directions'
items.description: The Pentagon discloses scores of UFO files with reported sightings of spheres, discs and fireballs spanning nearly 80 years.

items.title: One dead and dozens of firefighters injured in Staten Island shipyard explosion
items.description: More than 30 people, including firefighters, were hurt in the incident, which was described as "a complex, fast-developing emergency situation".

items.title: Bodies of Italian divers did not have optimal equipment, says rescuer
items.description: Images from a cave where the four Italians were found reveal the difficulty that rescuers had in recovering their bodies.
